criteria.requirement: A black loading screen has a centered white circular spinner that scales away before the scene is revealed.
criteria.action: Reload and observe the complete loading sequence.
criteria.expected: A centered white circular spinner appears on black and scales to zero as loading completes.

criteria.requirement: The introduction moves out from inside a lens to reveal a recognizable professional camera and John Doe, Photographer text.
criteria.action: Observe the introduction immediately after loading.
criteria.expected: The viewpoint pushes out from inside a lens to reveal a professional camera and John Doe, Photographer text.

criteria.requirement: Scrolling rotates the camera about 180 degrees, shows a project on its screen and title, and changes the backdrop to the blurred project image.
criteria.action: Scroll from the introduction into the first project.
criteria.expected: The camera rotates about 180 degrees, its screen shows the project/title, and the background becomes the blurred project image.

criteria.requirement: Subsequent projects transition smoothly while the project-view camera remains visually stable.
criteria.action: Scroll between successive projects and reverse direction.
criteria.expected: Project transitions are smooth while the camera remains stable in project view.

criteria.requirement: After the projects, scrolling reaches a top-down camera view with usable contact information.
criteria.expected: A top-down camera view appears with readable contact information below.

criteria.requirement: Opening a project zooms toward the image and transitions into a readable full-screen blog with the image at top.
criteria.action: Click a project and scroll through its article.
criteria.expected: The view zooms toward the photograph and enters a full-screen blog with photograph above black-on-white content.

criteria.requirement: The floating back action returns from the story to the matching camera-framed project, preserving navigation context.
criteria.action: Use the floating back button from an article.
criteria.expected: The blog transitions back into the same camera-framed project without losing navigation context.

scenarios.instruction: Observe loading and the lens-to-camera introduction.
Scroll across at least two projects, inspect the screen/background relationship and reach contact.
Open a project story, scroll its content, use the floating back button and reverse-scroll to verify restored context.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
